statement: Pinned xwiimote public documentation describes possible first-generation built-in MotionPlus units as gen15 or similar, but this is a descriptive potential devtype rather than a gen15 detector in the pinned Linux v6.12 classifier. libxwiimote requires the wiimote HID parent, discovers kernel-created input interfaces and opens the MotionPlus evdev child; it does not independently read integrated MotionPlus identification registers or reclassify a gen10 device by sensor presence.

applicability.revision: Early non-TR integrated Plus; descriptive gen15 label versus actual kernel v6.12 devtype
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. xwiimote.h 93-115; xwiimote core 335-393,611-672; Linux core 799-865. The code inspected has no kernel gen15 devtype. No runs.
